title: Add MAX_ROUTES_PER_MESSAGE limit to prevent memory exhaustion
description: DaoBackboneMessage.targets and .transit vectors have no size limit. Add MAX_ROUTES_PER_MESSAGE constant and validate in receive_from_peer before route reconstruction. Currently a malicious peer can send millions of routes in a single message to exhaust memory.
close_reason: Added MAX_ROUTES_PER_MESSAGE (256) constant and validation in receive_from_peer to reject messages with too many targets or transits. Includes TooManyRoutes error variant and test coverage.
